methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages were re-fetched and verified for each vendor on 2026-06-15: vitally.io/pricing, custify.com/pricing, totango.com/packages, planhat.com/pricing, churnzero.com (demo-only, no pricing page), gainsight.com/pricing, akitaapp.com/pricing, everafter.ai/pricing. Security/compliance sub-pages were fetched for certification data. ADVERSARIAL CORRECTIONS: (1) Totango's official packages page shows ONLY 'Talk to sales' for every tier — the prior draft's Starter $249 and Growth $1,099 came solely from a third-party aggregator (zoftwarehub.com) and have been nulled (null beats a guess). (2) Totango's forever-free 'Community Edition' could not be confirmed on the official page (only secondary sources), so freeTier and the $0 plan price were set to null. (3) ChurnZero publishes no named plan tiers; the fabricated 'Growth' and 'Enterprise' plans plus their invented contract-value ranges were removed and collapsed to a single quote-only plan. (4) Speculative third-party dollar figures were stripped from Custify, Planhat, Gainsight, EverAfter, and ChurnZero notes. Akita is the only vendor with fully published, verified self-serve prices ($49/$99/$499, 20% annual discount, 14-day trial). All other vendors are confirmed quote-only with monthlyUsd=null. Compliance claims were verified against vendor security pages: HIPAA is asserted only by ChurnZero and Gainsight. accessedAt 2026-06-15.
